descriptionPlain:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.


We are looking for a high-performing Accountant with strong technical accounting fundamentals and a finance transformation mindset. Beyond core accounting and reporting, you will help transform Finance through AI, automation, data and technology, improving efficiency, controls, scalability and decision-making.
Experience in consulting, finance transformation or technology-enabled finance, particularly within FinTech or digital assets, is highly valued.

We are looking for a high-performing Accountant with strong technical accounting fundamentals and a finance transformation mindset. Experience in consulting, finance transformation or technology-enabled finance, particularly within FinTech or digital assets, is highly valued.

lists.content:
• Manage financial and management reporting, including cash flow, tax, GST, budgeting and statutory reporting.
  • Prepare and review annual reports, statutory accounts and management reports.
  • Perform and review revenue, balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations and corporate governance requirements.
  • Liaise with auditors, tax agents and external advisors.
  • Identify and deliver opportunities to automate, simplify and transform finance processes.
  • Leverage AI, GenAI, automation, data analytics and technology to improve accounting efficiency, accuracy and scalability.
  • Partner with Finance Systems, Data, Engineering and business teams to implement technology-enabled finance solutions.
  • Lead or support process improvement and finance transformation initiatives, challenging existing ways of working.
  • Translate complex accounting requirements into practical, scalable solutions.

• Bachelor's degree in Accountancy / Finance, ACCA or equivalent professional qualification.
  • 8+ years' relevant experience in accounting, financial reporting, consulting or finance transformation.
  • Strong technical accounting, analytical and reconciliation skills.
  • Experience in finance transformation, automation or consulting is highly preferred.
  • Strong interest in AI, GenAI, automation, data and emerging finance technologies.
  • Advanced MS Excel skills; ERP, BI, workflow automation or financial systems experience is a plus.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and project management skills.
  • Able to work independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Highly detail-oriented, curious and willing to challenge the status quo.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Affiliate Relationship Manager (ARM) to manage and grow long-term relationships with key affiliates and channel partners across global markets.

This role is not focused on cold acquisition or aggressive business development. Instead, the ARM acts as a strategic partner manager responsible for affiliate retention, revenue growth, relationship stability, and risk awareness.

The ideal candidate understands the crypto/FX affiliate ecosystem deeply, is highly relationship-oriented, commercially sensitive, and capable of balancing growth with compliance and platform interests.

lists.content:
• Manage and maintain relationships with existing affiliates, KOLs, trading communities, and strategic partners
  • Drive affiliate performance growth across user acquisition, trading volume, retention, and revenue contribution
  • Monitor affiliate performance metrics and identify abnormal behaviors, risks, or growth opportunities
  • Handle affiliate concerns professionally, including commission disputes, competitor poaching, and operational escalations
  • Collaborate with internal teams including Marketing, Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Legal
  • Design and execute joint campaigns, incentive programs, and partnership initiatives with affiliates
  • Analyze affiliate ROI, trading behaviors, and lifecycle performance to improve overall ecosystem efficiency
  • Identify and prevent potential risks such as wash trading, arbitrage abuse, multi-accounting, or non-compliant traffic sources
  • Maintain strong market awareness of competitor affiliate programs, commission structures, and industry trends
  • Support affiliate onboarding, due diligence, and long-term relationship development

Industry Experience

  • Experience in Crypto, FX, CFD, Trading Platforms, or related financial industries
  • Familiar with exchange affiliate ecosystems, commission structures, and rebate mechanisms
  • Experience in Affiliate Marketing, Key Account Management (KAM), or B2B partnership management
  • Strong understanding of affiliate lifecycle management and partner incentive systems

    • Core Competencies

  • Strong relationship management and stakeholder communication skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive partner situations with maturity and professionalism
  • Good analytical skills with the ability to interpret trading volume, retention, ROI, and behavioral trends
  • Commercial negotiation capability for exclusive partnerships, tiered commissions, and co-marketing campaigns
  • Strong risk awareness regarding affiliate abuse, compliance concerns, and suspicious trading activities
  • Cross-cultural communication skills; experience managing LATAM, MENA, SEA, or global markets is preferred

    • Personality & Mindset

  • Patient, stable, and long-term relationship oriented
  • Strong service mindset and partnership mentality
  • High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal sensitivity
  • Able to detect early signals of affiliate churn, competitor engagement, or business decline
  • Self-driven, detail-oriented, and capable of working in a fast-paced environment

    • Nice to Have

  • Trading or quantitative trading background
  • Experience in compliance, risk control, or partner due diligence
  • Experience managing online communities or affiliate ecosystems
  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages such as Arabic, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese or Mandarin would be an advantage.

Binance is looking for a research-minded engineer to join the AI Infra team — sitting at the intersection of frontier model capabilities and real-world agent deployment. You'll work directly with researchers and engineers to push the boundaries of what AI agents can do: from Agentic RAG and context management to task execution, self-evolving agents, and multi-agent coordination.

This is not a pure engineering role and not a pure research role. It's both. You'll be expected to generate original ideas, run experiments, ship prototypes, and iterate fast based on real user feedback. The best candidate is someone who has already internalized agent tools into their daily workflow and has strong opinions about model behavior.

lists.content:
• Agentic RAG & Engineering: Design and operate next-generation retrieval pipelines — moving beyond static retrieve-once patterns to adaptive, self-correcting, and multi-hop retrieval workflows; architect Agentic RAG systems with dynamic retrieval control, query decomposition, iterative retrieve-reflect-refine loops, and multi-agent retrieval collaboration

  • Frontier Harness: Collaborate deeply with researchers and engineers to define and implement model-capability-driven innovations — including context management, long-term memory, subagent and multi-agent architectures, self-evolving agents, and real-word task execution

  • Benchmarking & Evaluation: Propose harness-domain and RAG-domain benchmarks and evaluation methodologies; construct benchmark datasets, define annotation strategies, and systematically measure and improve agent intelligence across domains — including retrieval efficiency, latency, groundedness, and task success rate

  • Real-world Feedback Loops: Leverage multi-channel user feedback and real-world task data as primary research signals; design experiments and datasets to continuously improve agent and retrieval performance in production scenarios

• 1+ Year hands-on experience with LLM, RAG and AI agent systems in production

  • RAG & Agentic RAG Engineering: Hands-on experience building production retrieval pipelines end-to-end — embedding models (BGE, OpenAI, etc.), vector stores (Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate), hybrid search (keyword + vector), reranking models; deep understanding of chunking strategy, text cleaning, and multimodal data parsing; experience implementing Agentic RAG patterns — Self-RAG, Corrective RAG, adaptive retrieval, multi-hop decomposition, retrieve-reflect-refine loops

  • Agent Harness Engineering — hands-on experience with Agent Harness runtimes (Pi Agent, AgentScope 2.0 or equivalent orchestration frameworks): session recovery, sandbox isolation, middleware/hook systems, multi-tenant runtime, plan/execute loops, and retrieval-grounded tool calling

  • LLM & Agent Fundamentals: Deep familiarity with LLM and agent mechanisms — LLM APIs, KV Cache, Agent Loop, Tool Use, Reasoning, Planning, Skills, MCP, Memory, Subagent, Multi-Agent; strong grasp of Prompt Engineering, Context Engineering

  • Independent Research Capability: Can analyze ambiguous problems from first principles, generate original ideas, and drive research from 0 to 1; able to rapidly translate ideas into runnable prototypes with tight experiment iteration loops

  • Heavy Agent User: Power user of agent products (coding agents, general-purpose agents); agent tools are already integrated into your daily work and life; you have taste and judgment about model behavior

  • AI-native Engineering: Proficient in vibe coding — ships fast using AI-assisted workflows across unfamiliar languages, frameworks, and domains; strong learning velocity in software development

    • Nice to Have

  • Deep hands-on experience with agent products such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, Cowork, Manus, or equivalent — already integrated into your workflow or daily life

  • RAG evaluation: Experience with RAGAS, TruLens, or custom benchmarking pipelines for retrieval quality, groundedness, and latency profiling

  • GraphRAG / knowledge graph-augmented retrieval experience

  • Experience with Pi Agent, AgentScope 2.0 or other Agent Harness: middleware composition, multi-tenant session management, plugin architecture, sandbox backends

  • Background in model training, RLHF, or model–system co-design

  • LiteLLM / multi-provider proxy experience

  • Kubernetes/EKS: pod isolation, resource management, secrets handling

  • Security engineering: prompt injection defense, sandbox hardening, guardrail design

lists.content:
Financial Controllership & Day-to-Day Finance Management

  • Own end-to-end finance operations for several APAC legal entities across multiple jurisdictions, including month-end and year-end closing processes.

  • Oversee bank, asset, intercompany, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Review and approve journal entries, accruals, provisions, invoices, payment requests, and other accounting records.

  • Prepare and review financial statements and management reports in accordance with applicable accounting standards and group policies.

  • Ensure timely completion of regulatory, statutory, tax, and compliance-related filings in partnership with internal teams and external advisors.

  • Manage day-to-day relationships with banks, vendors, accounting service providers, tax advisors, auditors, and other external stakeholders.

  • Partner closely with Treasury, Tax, Global Accounting, Legal, Compliance, and business teams to ensure smooth financial operations.

    • Accounting Quality & Financial Reporting

  • Ensure complete, accurate, and timely accounting for all responsible entities, including oversight of local accounting and tax vendors where applicable.

  • Review and define accounting treatments and methodologies for new business activities, products, and operational flows.

  • Maintain strong financial discipline by validating journal entries, reviewing reconciliations, and ensuring proper documentation of accounting judgments.

  • Identify and resolve accounting issues, reporting gaps, and process inconsistencies across entities and jurisdictions.

  • Support the continuous improvement of accounting systems, financial reporting processes, and closing procedures.

    • Internal Controls & Governance

  • Develop, document, and maintain business processes, accounting policies, and internal control procedures to support a strong control environment.

  • Ensure compliance with group accounting policies, delegated authority frameworks, and internal control requirements.

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and well-documented financial records to support internal reviews, audits, and regulatory inquiries.

  • Identify control gaps, operational risks, and process weaknesses, and drive timely remediation.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and financial discipline across the region.

    • Audit Coordination

  • Lead and coordinate external audits for responsible APAC entities, ensuring timely completion and high-quality audit deliverables.

  • Act as the key point of contact for auditors, local finance teams, external accounting partners, and internal stakeholders.

  • Prepare and review audit schedules, supporting documentation, financial statements, and management representation materials.

  • Address audit findings, resolve open issues, and implement corrective actions where needed.

  • Support statutory audits, group audits, tax audits, and other regulatory reviews as required.

    • Annual Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead the annual budgeting and rolling forecast processes for the APAC vertical, including revenue, marketing, operating expenses, headcount, and local spend.

  • Partner with business leaders and management to align financial targets with strategic priorities.

  • Monitor actual performance against budget and forecast, identify variances, and provide clear explanations and actionable recommendations.

  • Drive high P&L forecast accuracy throughout the fiscal year to support timely business decisions and resource allocation.

  • Provide financial input into investment decisions, cost optimization initiatives, and regional growth plans.

    • Business Partnership & Strategic Analysis

  • Act as a trusted finance partner to regional and vertical management teams, providing clear, data-driven, and commercially relevant insights.

  • Build financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases to support strategic decision-making.

  • Translate financial results and trends into practical recommendations for senior stakeholders.

  • Support new market, product, and operational initiatives by assessing financial implications, risks, controls, and reporting requirements.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure Finance is embedded early in business planning and execution.

    • Process Improvement & Automation

  • Drive continuous improvement in accounting, reporting, forecasting, and finance operations processes.

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual work, streamline workflows, improve data quality, and enhance reporting efficiency.

  • Implement best practices in financial reporting, closing processes, reconciliations, and controls.

  • Partner with systems, data, and finance transformation teams to enhance enterprise-level finance tools and reporting capabilities.

  • Support scalable finance infrastructure as the business grows across the region.

    • Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of finance professionals across the region.

  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented team culture.

  • Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for team members.

  • Partner with Central Finance to deliver training on accounting standards, financial policies, reporting requirements, and internal controls.

  • Build finance capabilities to support business complexity, regulatory expectations, and organizational growth.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline. CPA, CMA, ACCA, CA, MBA, or Master’s degree preferred.

  • 10+ years of relevant finance experience, including controllership, financial accounting, financial planning and analysis, audit, or finance business partnering.

  • Prior experience as a Finance Manager, Financial Controller, Regional Controller, or Finance Business Partner within a multinational, listed company, technology, fintech, financial services, or high-growth environment preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, statutory reporting, tax filings, general ledger operations, and month-end/year-end closing processes.

  • Experience managing financial operations across multiple APAC jurisdictions is strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of internal controls, audit processes, accounting policies, and financial governance frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise-level ERP, accounting, consolidation, and financial planning systems.

  • Excellent financial modelling, analytical, problem-solving, and business partnering skills.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate clearly and influence senior stakeholders.

  • Highly proactive, detail-oriented, and able to operate independently with limited supervision.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environment.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and bring structure to complex situations.

  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and people leadership skills.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required. Mandarin language capability is a plus for collaboration with cross-regional stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated interest in digital assets, crypto, blockchain technology, fintech, or Web3 is an advantage.

    • Preferred Attributes

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate both strategically and hands-on.

  • Commercially minded finance leader who can balance control, compliance, and business enablement.

  • Experience working with distributed, cross-functional, and multicultural teams.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial topics for non-finance stakeholders.

  • High integrity, strong judgment, and commitment to maintaining robust financial governance.

    •

description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

About the Team

The Binance Pay&Card team is revolutionizing the way people transact and manage their finances globally. Binance Pay is a cutting-edge payment solution that enables users to send, receive, and pay with crypto seamlessly. Join us to be part of a dynamic team driving the future of digital payments and financial technology.

Role Overview

As a Backend Architect on the Pay&Card Team, you will be responsible for architecting and building card-related systems end to end. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design scalable, secure, and compliant infrastructure that supports card systems and lifecycle management.

lists.content:
• Architect, build, and maintain backend systems for card issuing and card lifecycle management

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of card certification processes (Visa, MasterCard, Apple Pay / Google Pay onboarding programs)

  • Define and drive the system architecture, service boundaries, and integration patterns for card platform services

  • Ensure system reliability, scalability, and compliance with payment network standards

  • Collaborate with product, compliance, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications

  • Establish engineering best practices, code quality standards, and technical documentation for the team

  • Work hands-on — this is a builder role, not a pure advisory position

• 8+ years of backend engineering experience with strong Java / Spring expertise

  • Direct experience building or maintaining a card system  

  • Experience with card certification processes and/or card onboarding programs

  • Strong system design and architecture skills, with experience in distributed systems and high-throughput payment infrastructure

  • Understanding of card network standards, payment flows, and compliance requirements

• Experience at a fintech, startup, or crypto company that has issued cards

  • Familiarity with card lifecycle management, tokenization, and payment gateway integrations

  • Experience working in agile, fast-paced environments with short release cycles

lists.content:
• Assist in developing and maintaining SQL-based data pipelines and analytics workflows
  • Support data standardization and normalization projects (e.g., address parsing, entity resolution)
  • Help build and optimize data models, dashboards, and reports
  • Conduct ad-hoc data analysis under mentorship and present findings to the team
  • Assist in monitoring data quality and implementing validation logic
  • Collaborate with team members on cross-functional data projects

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field
  • Solid SQL skills, familiarity with Hive/Spark SQL is a plus
  • Basic proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python preferred)
  • Strong interest in data analytics, risk control, or fraud detection
  • Good communication skills, eagerness to learn and take initiative
  • Available for at least 3 days per week, minimum 3-month internship duration

descriptionPlain:
Binance is the leading global blockchain ecosystem and cryptocurrency infrastructure provider whose suite of financial products includes the world’s largest digital-asset exchange.
Our mission is to accelerate cryptocurrency adoption and increase the freedom of money.
 
If you’re looking for a fast-paced, mission-driven organization where opportunities to learn and excel are endless, then Binance is the place for you.
 
About Binance Accelerator Program
 
Binance Accelerator Program is a concise fixed-term program designed for Early Career Talent to have an immersive experience in the rapidly expanding Web3 space. You will be given the opportunity to experience life at Binance and understand what goes on behind the scenes of the worlds’ leading blockchain ecosystem. Alongside your job, there will also be a focus on networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about BAP Program HERE
 
Who may apply
 
Current university students and recent graduates
For applicants in full time education, we will accommodate part time working to enable them to continue to focus on their studies

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.
 
Who may apply
Current university students and recent graduates.

You will work alongside senior analysts on real product analytics projects — including conversion funnel analysis, A/B experiment evaluation, and dashboard building. This is a hands-on role where you'll gain exposure to product strategy, experiment-driven decision making, and large-scale data infrastructure.

We are looking for a motivated Product Data Analyst Intern to join our Product DA team. You will work alongside senior analysts on real product analytics projects — including conversion funnel analysis, A/B experiment evaluation, and dashboard building. This is a hands-on role where you'll gain exposure to product strategy, experiment-driven decision making, and large-scale data infrastructure.

lists.content:
• Assist in building and analyzing user conversion funnels, identifying drop-off points and improvement opportunities
  • Support A/B experiment evaluation: pull experiment data, validate cohort allocation (sanity checks), calculate uplift metrics, and summarize results
  • Build and maintain dashboards for key product metrics (CTR, conversion rate, UV/PV)
  • Respond to product team ad-hoc data requests — user segmentation, feature adoption tracking, campaign performance analysis
  • Write and maintain SQL queries for scheduled data pipelines; assist in data quality monitoring
  • Translate data findings into clear summaries and visualizations for product teams

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or related field)
  • Internship experience in product analytics or related data analysis roles preferred
  • A natural curiosity to identify, investigate and explain trends and patterns in data
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.
  • Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals (hypothesis testing, p-value, confidence intervals)
  • Strong logical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work independently
  • Fast learner with curiosity about product strategy and user behavior
  • Competency in one or more of the following:
  • SQL (able to write complex queries with CTEs, window functions, subqueries)
  • Programming (Python/R for data manipulation)
  • A data visualization tool (e.g. DataWind, Tableau, PowerBI)

• Experience with event tracking / behavioral analytics (Sensors, Mixpanel, GA)
  • Familiarity with Airflow or data scheduling tools
  • Interest in crypto/fintech industry
  • Prior experience with large-scale data (Hive/Spark environment)

descriptionPlain:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.


Binance is the global blockchain company behind the world’s largest digital asset exchange by trading volume and users, serving a greater mission to accelerate cryptocurrency adoption and increase the freedom of money.
 
Are you looking to be a part of the most influential company in the blockchain industry and contribute to the cryptocurrency revolution that is changing the world?
 
We are looking for a proactive and driven early careers talent to join our Binance Academy team. You will support our team to help build long-term partnerships with student organizations and universities. On top of that, you will also develop and execute various outreach activities and communication strategies on blockchain and crypto. You will help us to build web3 courses in various formats that will facilitate crypto adoption among learners and connect with schools across the globe. 
 
The successful early careers talent will also play a key part in managing our newly formed student ambassador program in their allocated region and contribute to the overall success of the team by closely working with other Binance local teams across the globe. In collaboration with a Business Development Specialist, you will help to devise innovative ways to build partnerships and encourage students to participate in various Binance programs both on and off campus.

lists.content:
1. Manage and follow up on user feedback: Focus on collecting, organizing, and tracking user feedback from users, customer support, or internal teams. Identify issue types, impact scope, and priority, and drive relevant stakeholders to resolve issues efficiently.

2. Support product issue coordination and execution: Assist in identifying and organizing product-related issues, coordinate with Product, Engineering, Design, Compliance, and other teams to push for resolution, and track progress until closure.

3. Support day-to-day product operations: Participate in daily product operations work, including feedback management, requirement organization, issue tracking, and process optimization, to improve collaboration efficiency and user experience.

4. Handle basic data processing and analysis: Support data-related tasks such as data cleaning, organization, reporting, and basic analysis to help inform product improvements and operational decisions.

5. Support basic Web-side product tasks: Assist with basic Web-side product work, including pop-up configuration, minor UI adjustments, and maintenance of certain pages such as HR recruitment pages and compliance-related pages. Each area will have dedicated product manager support.

6. Support AI-related projects: Participate in AI-related project support, including requirement coordination, workflow follow-up, and feedback collection. Experience with AI tools or AI-related projects is a strong plus.

1. Bachelor’s or Master’s student, strong interest in internet products, product operations, or user experience. Previous internship experience in related fields is a plus.

2. Strong problem-solving mindset: Results-oriented and execution-driven, with the ability to proactively communicate, push issues forward, and focus on solving problems effectively.

3. Excellent communication and collaboration skills : Able to work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Support, and Compliance, with strong coordination and execution skills.

4. Basic data handling and analytical skills :Comfortable with basic data organization, reporting, and analysis. Familiarity with Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools is preferred.

5. AI-related skills or experience are a plus : Interest in AI products, AI tools, or AI-related projects is preferred. Hands-on experience in AI projects would be a strong advantage.

6. Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.

7. Internship availability: Available to work 3-5 days per week for at least 6 months.

lists.content: We are building cutting-edge AI systems that enable the next generation of intelligent applications. Our team focuses on developing AI agents, benchmarking datasets, and robust infrastructure to support real-world deployments at scale. As part of our engineering-driven culture, you'll be exposed to a fast-paced environment where experimentation, collaboration, and innovation are encouraged.

- Contribute to the design and development of AI agents integrated into live production systems
- Help build and maintain benchmark datasets to evaluate agent performance, accuracy, and safety
- Design and refine prompts, tool integrations, and agent workflows
- Implement, test, and optimize services and tooling across the stack — backend, data, scripting, automation, and glue code
- Collaborate closely with senior engineers on system design, multi-agent orchestration, and deployment
- Participate in code reviews, debugging, and documentation to ensure best practices
- Work in a team environment that encourages mentorship, knowledge sharing, and hands-on learning

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Strong programming fundamentals — language-agnostic, but practical experience with at least one of Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar
- Solid understanding of software engineering principles (data structures, algorithms, version control)
- Familiarity or working knowledge of any AI agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, hermes-agent, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen)
- Interest in AI, data-driven systems, and building tools for real-world applications
- Good communication skills and willingness to learn quickly

- AI-native working style — you naturally reach for AI tools in your daily workflow, not as an afterthought but as a core part of how you think, build, and solve problems
- Eager to learn and open-minded — you stay current with the latest technologies and aren't afraid to adopt new frameworks, tools, or paradigms before they're mainstream
- First-principles thinker who's comfortable redesigning workflows rather than just optimizing existing ones

- Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or building tools on top of AI models
- Exposure to multi-agent systems or agent orchestration patterns
- Familiarity with Docker, cloud platforms, or CI/CD pipelines
- Machine learning knowledge is a plus, but not required

1. AI Products: Work as a core member on company-level AI initiatives, from concept to launch — covering industry research, product definition, prototype review, user testing, and post-launch data analysis.
  2. Defi (Stablecoin) Products: Track market trends, leading competitors, and on-chain data; produce decision-ready research memos. Contribute to product design, write PRDs, follow projects through development and launch, and support early-stage ecosystem partnership conversations.
  3. Cross-Functional Proeject Management: Act as a key coordinator across multiple parallel workstreams — driving alignment on goals, pacing, and risks to keep complex projects on track.
  4. Decision Support: Help produce internal and external materials, bilingual (CN/EN) writing and translation, and industry/data insights that feed directly into business decisions.
  5. Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) as a daily working habit to scale personal output.

1. Currently enrolled in Finance or Computer Science (or related); senior undergrad or graduate students preferred. Dual-degree (Finance + CS / AI) is a plus.
  2. Fully bilingual in Chinese and English — able to write memos, emails, and meeting notes independently in both languages and switch fluently in bilingual settings.
  3. Genuine interest and basic understanding. Hands-on trading or on-chain experience preferred — able to clearly articulate what you've used and the reasoning behind your decisions.
  4. Active interest and hands-on exploration in AI, with demonstrable personal projects, demos, writing, or GitHub work. Background in HCI or big-data analytics is a plus.
  5. Self-directed and structured — able to break down ambiguous problems and move forward independently, with consistent output in a fast-paced environment.
  6. Strong communication and coordination skills — able to keep information and progress flowing across multiple teams.

  Nice to Have

  1. Entrepreneurial experience, leadership in student organizations, or large-scale event coordination.
  2. Prior internships at top tech companies, financial institutions, or Web3 projects.
  3. Public research or writing output (industry reports, in-depth posts, newsletters, etc.).
  4. Your own perspective on the Defi space or major crypto products.

About the Role
This position is for students who are excited about applying AI to improve how software is built. You will work on real-world projects that explore how large language models and AI tools can enhance developer productivity and engineering workflows.
You’ll gain hands-on experience building AI-powered tools and contributing to a growing internal AI platform.
 

 
What You Will Do
Assist in building AI tools such as coding assistants, automation scripts, and knowledge Q&A systems
Support the development of LLM-based applications (e.g., prompt optimization, lightweight RAG pipelines)
Contribute to initiatives that improve engineering efficiency and developer experience
Help test, iterate, and document internal AI tools and platforms
Research and experiment with emerging AI technologies and use cases
 

 
What We're Looking For
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python preferred)
Strong fundamentals in programming and problem-solving
Interest in AI, especially large language models (LLMs)
Experience using tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar
Familiarity with basic software development workflows (e.g., Git, debugging)
Good communication skills and willingness to learn
 

 
Bonus Points
Experience with AI-related projects (e.g., chatbots, NLP, automation tools)
Exposure to Prompt Engineering or AI-assisted development workflows
Coursework or basic knowledge in machine learning or NLP
Personal projects, technical blogs, or GitHub portfolio

About the Role

You'll work alongside senior research scientists on problems at the frontier of LLM reasoning, post-training methodology, and agentic AI — in one of the few environments where your models interact with live global markets at scale.

This isn't a support or literature-review role. You'll run experiments, form independent hypotheses, implement ideas from recent papers, and work closely with engineering teams to understand how research behaves under real production constraints — 24/7, zero-downtime, hundreds of millions of users.

lists.content:
• Design and run experiments in reasoning model training, post-training alignment, test-time compute scaling, and systematic model evaluation — grounded in financial and crypto-native problem settings
  • Implement model variants, training pipelines (including RLVR-based approaches), and evaluation frameworks in PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem
  • Synthesize recent work from NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, and ACL to sharpen active research directions — not just track the field, but translate it into testable ideas
  • Apply LLM reasoning to crypto-native data: on-chain signals, market microstructure, and multi-modal market intelligence — research opportunities that don't exist anywhere else
  • Maintain rigorous experiment tracking and reproducibility standards (W&B or equivalent)
  • Partner with applied engineering to understand how research translates into production systems — and what constraints actually matter

• Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field (preferably graduating between 2026 to 2028)
  • Strong Python and PyTorch fundamentals; C++ or Rust exposure is a bonus 
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as a natural part of your research workflow — not as a crutch, but as leverage
  • Solid grounding in transformer architectures, LLM pretraining, and the shift toward reasoning-capable models
  • You form opinions about research, not just summaries of it

lists.content:
You'll work directly on the AI systems powering Binance AI Products and next-generation agentic trading features — alongside the full-time algorithm team, on real production challenges.

You own deliverables, run experiments, and ship code that matters. You build components of AI systems (agents, pipelines, evaluation tools), debug real systems, and work with engineers to ship features that reach users.

This is not a "watch and learn" program. You are expected to build, contribute, and ship.

• Contribute to the design and development of LLM-powered pipelines for agentic trading — including reasoning agent components, tool-use frameworks via MCP, and automated workflow execution across crypto markets.

  • Build and evaluate prompt engineering strategies, test-time scaling approaches, and retrieval architectures for crypto-native data sources — on-chain data, market feeds, news, and sentiment signals.

  • Design and run model evaluation experiments — defining quality metrics for agent reasoning in financial contexts, executing benchmarks, and synthesizing results into actionable findings.

  • Analyze agent performance characteristics in live trading scenarios — covering decision accuracy, latency, reliability, and adversarial robustness.

  • Apply AI-native development practices using agentic coding tools as a standard part of the engineering workflow — writing and executing Python code for strategy logic, data pipelines, and agent evaluation.

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related technical field.

  • Expected graduation in 2026 or 2027.

  • Strong Python programming skills with demonstrated AI-native development practices — you use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot Workspace) as a core part of your workflow.

  • Foundational understanding of how large language models work — attention mechanisms, prompting, and the difference between standard generation and reasoning models.

  • Structured problem-solving approach and ability to operate independently on defined tasks.

  • Investigate and improve Agent quality, including failure analysis, regression detection, prompt / workflow optimization, and guardrail effectiveness.
  • Improve system observability and reliability through tracing, metrics, logging, dashboards, and production monitoring.
  • Debug issues across asynchronous services and agent pipelines, and build integration tests using mocked LLM responses and replayable evaluation cases.
  • Work closely with Backend, Data Science, and Algorithm engineers to experiment, benchmark, and bring AI capabilities into production.

• Strong Python programming skills and solid software engineering fundamentals.
  • Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and problem solving; able to reason about system behavior and trade-offs.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM applications or Agent systems, through research, coursework, internships, or projects.
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Prompting, Agent workflows, or LLM evaluation.
  • Able to work comfortably with real codebases, APIs, asynchronous services, testing, CI/CD, and code review.
  • Strong debugging and analytical ability, with a mindset of "understand why it fails, not just make it work."

• Experience with Agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AgentScope, LlamaIndex, or similar.
  • Experience with MCP / Tool ecosystems / Agent Runtime.
  • Experience building Benchmark / Evaluation / LLM testing infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with vector search, embeddings, RAG evaluation, or LLM observability.
  • Experience with Redis, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-native systems.
  • Exposure to LLM security, guardrails, prompt-injection defense, or tool-use safety.
  • Experience with model inference, latency optimization, or cost optimization.

• Ship real features to a production AI Agent used by Binance users.
  • Work on the Agent Runtime and AI infrastructure, rather than only application-layer development.
  • Learn from senior Backend, Data Science and Algorithm engineers.
  • Gain hands-on experience across the modern LLM application stack: Agent Runtime, RAG, Tool Calling, Evaluation, LLMOps and AI Safety.
  • Own meaningful engineering projects end-to-end, from problem definition → implementation → evaluation → production.

descriptionBody:
About the Team

Binance AI Pro is building the next generation of AI-native experiences within Binance.

At the core of AI Pro is an agentic system that can understand user intent, reason through multi-step tasks, retrieve information, call tools, and safely execute actions across Binance's ecosystem.

As a Backend Engineer Intern, you'll work directly on the Agent Runtime and AI infrastructure behind these experiences — from intent routing and tool orchestration to evaluation, observability, and reliability. We're looking for strong technical students who enjoy going deep — people who are excited by LLM Agents, systems, algorithms, and experimentation, and wants to work on real production AI systems alongside experienced Backend, Data Science, and Algorithm engineers.

You will have the opportunity to turn ideas from prototype → benchmark → production, and see your work directly impact how AI Pro behaves at scale.

lists.content:
We are looking for someone who is careful, detail-oriented, and interested in LLMs and AI Agents.

What you will work on: You will support AI-related projects in compliance and risk control areas, including:
  • KYC (Know Your Customer): helping improve processes for identity verification, document review, and user onboarding
  • KYB (Know Your Business): supporting business entity verification and related due diligence workflows
  • EDD (Enhanced Due Diligence): assisting with more complex review cases, risk signals, and investigation support
  • Helping test and optimize LLM/Agent-based workflows for compliance operations
  • Reviewing prompts, automation logic, and model outputs
  • Documenting findings, edge cases, and process improvements
  • Supporting small-scale implementation, evaluation, and operational analysis tasks

• Undergraduate or postgraduate background in business data analytics, computer science or a related field.
  •  Some hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI Agents
  • Basic coding or scripting ability is a plus
  • Interest in compliance, risk control, or operational efficiency is a plusIf you are reliable, practical, and excited about applying AI to real business workflows
  • Responsible and patient in repetitive or process-heavy work
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Mandarin to be able to coordinate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Capable of creating clear documentation and presentations.
  • Strong sense of ownership, with a collaborative, hands-on approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Leveraging knowledge of large-scale models and intelligent agents, participate in the design and development of a series of AI-powered financial trading agency skills based on Web3 data, and integrate them into practical systems.

Perform post-training of large-scale language models (SFT, RL, etc.) to enhance the model's ability to utilize Binance's internal trading skills.

Assist in building and maintaining benchmark datasets to evaluate the performance of AI systems, and assist in building and iterating workflow prototypes for financial AI agent systems.

Work closely with senior engineers to complete system design, integration, and deployment.

Currently pursuing or holding a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Financial Engineering, Automation, or a related field.

Hands-on experience with post-training techniques such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RLHF / RLAIF) . Familiar with common fine-tuning and reinforcement learning frameworks, such as Llama Factory, Slime, Verl, and OpenRLHF.

Familiarity with at least one mainstream deep learning framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and common LLM training/evaluation toolkits (Hugging Face Transformers, DeepSpeed, vLLM, etc.).

Excellent communication skills and a strong willingness to learn quickly.

Able to commit at least 6 months, working 5 days a week.

• Participate in the design and development of algorithm strategies for user growth, including but not limited to user segmentation, intelligent recommendation, and incentive strategy optimization.

  • Build user lifecycle models (LTV prediction, churn warning, conversion prediction, etc.) based on user behavior data to drive precision operations and decision-making.

  • Design and implement A/B testing experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of growth strategies and drive continuous iteration and optimization.

opening:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.
 
About Binance Accelerator Program
Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.
 
Who may apply
Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws

lists.content:
• Assist in the development and maintenance of iOS architecture and foundational modules;
  • Support the design and implementation of reusable components, tools, and frameworks for iOS applications;
  • Participate in improving code quality, performance, stability, and engineering efficiency;
  • Collaborate with engineers to optimize app architecture, module structure, and development workflows;
  • Help identify and troubleshoot technical issues in iOS applications;
  • Contribute to internal tooling, automation, and developer experience improvements;
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support product and technical initiatives when needed;

• Current student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field;
  • Hands-on experience in iOS development;
  • Familiarity with Swift and/or Objective-C
  • Understanding of iOS fundamentals, including:
    UIKit and/or SwiftUI
    app lifecycle
    networking
    multithreading basics
    memory management
  • Basic understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, and algorithms;
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn;
  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
  • Available for a 6-month full-time commitment;

lists.content: You will join the Macro Research team within Binance Research, the function behind the firm’s externally published thought leadership and the market narratives that shape how digital assets are understood, as well as the strategic intelligence relied on internally. The team’s work spans the macro backdrop for digital assets, market structure and regulation, and the structural themes shaping the industry, from tokenization and real-world assets to DeFi, and it reaches a global audience of institutions, media, and the wider crypto community.

• Support the Macro Research team across the full research cycle, from data gathering and chart production to drafting and fact-checking.

  • Help produce the team’s industry and thematic research.

  • Track macro and crypto-market developments, from rates, liquidity, and capital flows to regulation, market structure, and emerging themes, drawing on market data, on-chain data, and other sources to surface what matters.

  • Build and maintain the datasets, models, and visualizations that underpin the team’s research.

  • Bring strong attention to detail to every analysis, alongside genuine curiosity about where the market is heading.

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree; Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field is a plus.

  • Good knowledge of crypto and a genuine passion for the industry; familiarity with macro and markets is a plus.

  • Comfortable working with data and translating it into clear analysis and well-designed charts; familiarity with data tools and on-chain analytics is a plus.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, self-driven, with strong work ethic and the ability to thrive in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.

  • Able to commit a minimum of 3 days per week for at least 6 months.

Responsibilities

- Support daily operations of Binance DEX, including on-chain trading and liquidity monitoring.
- Research and analyze prediction market platforms (e.g., Polymarket) and on-chain trading trends.
- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, automation, etc.) to improve operational efficiency and data analysis.
- Track trading metrics, user feedback, and identify areas for improvement.
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to support product launches.

Requirements

- Have hands-on prediction market / on-chain trading experience.
- Familiar with AI applications to boost productivity.
- Able to pick up new Web3 and DeFi concepts quickly.
- Basic analytics skills (spreadsheets, dashboards).
- Self-starter, organized, and detail-oriented.
- Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.
- Available 5 days/week for 3–6 months longer durance is a plus.

lists.content:
• Assist the Earn Regulatory team with daily compliance project management and product operations across Simple Earn, Staking, On-Chain Yields, Loans, and related products.

  • Track and manage regulatory project timelines, deliverables, and dependencies end-to-end — ensuring milestones, sign-offs, and confirmation deadlines are met across jurisdictions.

  • Prepare and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), compliance trackers, meeting summaries, and status reports for ongoing regulatory requirements, product suggestions & workstreams.

  • Coordinate and align on a regular basis with cross-functional stakeholders (Legal, Product, Engineering, local compliance teams, and regional leads) as well as internal stakeholders within Binance Earn.

  • Monitor regulatory developments and product configuration changes across markets, flagging risks and open issues to the team proactively.

  • Act as the DRP (Direct Responsible Person) or POC (Point of Contact) for assigned regulatory workstreams — chasing action items, documenting decisions, and following up with stakeholders on outstanding deliverables.

  • Support regulatory reviews of product configurations (e.g. product availability, whitelist/blacklist logic, UI/wording changes) by consolidating requirements and evidence from multiple teams.

  • Help maintain accurate records and audit trails of regulatory decisions, approvals, and remediation actions across all jurisdictions.

  • Support the broader Earn Growth agenda where regulatory and growth workstreams intersect — e.g. market openings, product launches, and TVL initiatives — ensuring compliance requirements are embedded in execution.

  • Assist with ad-hoc regulatory analysis, data requests, and presentation materials for internal and external stakeholders.

• 0–2 years of relevant experience (internship or entry-level) in project management

  • Strong interest in crypto, DeFi, and Web3 regulation — a proactive habit of researching regulatory and industry developments is highly valued.

  • Familiarity with or willingness to learn crypto regulatory frameworks across key jurisdictions (e.g. MiCA/EU, ADGM/FSRA, UK FCA, HK SFC, PH SEC, Japan FSA) — prior exposure to any of these is a strong plus.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accountability 

  • Highly organized, with proven ability to track multiple concurrent projects, dependencies, and deadlines across time zones.

  • Excellent logical thinking, written communication, and presentation skills 

  • Comfortable coordinating across large cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder follow-ups independently.

  • Takes full ownership of tasks and outcomes, not just inputs. Self-learning personality and ability to work independently and resolve problems end to end as the DRP/POC. 

  • Ability to handle a fast-paced environment with changing requirements based on regulatory and business needs 

  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders; based in Asia time zone UTC+8 (±2) is preferred.

  • Openness to feedback and a strong willingness to continuously improve.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally in large teams and managing stakeholder relations is necessary.

  • Have read and understood Binance’s Core Values & CZ’s Principle.

• During the interview rounds, candidates may be required to complete a practical assignment followed by a final presentation to demonstrate attention to detail, business sense, and structured thinking.

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science
  • Strong interest in AI products, Agent products, AIGC applications, automation tools, or developer tooling.
  • Interest in or exposure to Web3, exchanges, wallets, payments, on-chain transactions, DeFi, or crypto assets.
  • Basic understanding of how AI Agents work — tool-calling, task planning, context management, or evaluation frameworks (coursework, projects, or self-study all count).
  • Strong ownership and learning agility; comfortable navigating ambiguity and picking things up quickly.
  • Solid product fundamentals — able to write clear PRDs, flow diagrams, test cases, and acceptance criteria (even at a learning level).
  • Excellent communication skills across engineering, design, operations, and business stakeholders.

• Personal projects or coursework related to AI Agents, prompt engineering, or LLM applications.
  • Experience with or exposure to exchanges, Web3 wallets, on-chain trading, payments, or fintech products.
  • Familiarity with MCP, Function Calling, RAG, multi-Agent orchestration, or workflow automation.
  • Knowledge of the Binance ecosystem or mainstream Web3 user scenarios.

descriptionPlain:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.
 
About Binance Accelerator Program
Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.
 
Who may apply
Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws
 


Binance Square is Binance’s content community business, covering modules such as Feed recommendation, content publishing, livestreaming, creator center, and content moderation. Since its launch, it has gone through 65 product iterations and currently maintains a release cycle of one version every three weeks. The product spans six platforms: Android, iOS, Web, Admin, Mini Program, and Backend.
You will join a 3-person QA team and participate in the full testing cycle of a real, high-traffic product. The team has already built a relatively complete toolchain, including automated tracking validation, test data generation plugins, regression scripts, and an online test case platform. You will not need to build everything from scratch; instead, you will be able to ramp up quickly within a mature process and make practical contributions.

The team has already built a relatively complete toolchain, including automated tracking validation, test data generation plugins, regression scripts, and an online test case platform. lists.content:
• Execute functional and regression testing across multiple platforms (Android / iOS / Web / Admin) based on test cases, and use the team’s existing scripts and online spreadsheets to record execution results.
  • Use the team’s in-house event tracking validation tools to capture and compare logs, determine whether data reporting complies with specifications, and file tickets for any uncovered tracking points.
  • Cross-platform compatibility checks and online issue reproduction
  • Verify differences in how the same feature performs across different platforms and versions, and reproduce and document issues reported from production.
  • Test data preparation - Use the team’s test data generation tools to prepare test accounts and content scenarios.
  • Submit clear and reproducible bug reports, and follow up on fixes through verification until closure.
  • Test case repository maintenance
  • Update test case documentation in sync with requirement changes.

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Management, or a related field
  • Understanding of basic software testing concepts, including test cases, bug lifecycle, and priority classification
    Able to use Chrome DevTools to inspect network requests and console logs, with a basic understanding of HTTP and JSON
  • Detail-oriented and patient, with the ability to complete repetitive validation tasks with high quality
    Strong written communication skills, with the ability to clearly describe reproduction steps, expected results, and actual results

We are looking for a talented Quality Assurance Engineer who has a passion for software and quality. This individual will work closely with engineers and the product team to review new features as well as develop and execute test scenarios which will help improve the quality of our software for Binance Wallet. You will also help the QA team become more efficient by contributing to writing automated tests for our mobile/web/browser extension apps.

• Participate in the testing of Binance backend microservices, ensuring high-quality delivery across service APIs and integration boundaries.
  • Understand business scenarios and technical design (domain models, database schemas, service-to-service contracts); design, develop, and execute test cases, and organize test case reviews.
  • Execute functional, integration, and regression testing at the API and service layer; identify and track bugs, and ensure timely fixes and delivery.

About the Role

For all students looking to gain hands-on experience! You'll work directly with senior scientists on research problems at the frontier of LLM reasoning, post-training methodology, and agentic AI — applied to global crypto markets. Your work has a direct path to production systems serving hundreds of millions of users, and where findings warrant it, a clear path to external publication.

You run experiments, implement ideas from recent research, synthesize papers into hypotheses, and work with engineers to understand how research translates to real systems.

This is not a purely literature-review or passive research role. You are expected to think independently and generate insight.

lists.content:
• Contribute to the design and execution of experiments in reasoning model training, post-training alignment, test-time scaling, or systematic model evaluation — with a focus on applications in financial and crypto-native contexts

  • Review and synthesize recent academic literature at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, and ACL — tracking developments in reasoning, alignment, and agentic AI to inform and sharpen ongoing research directions

  • Implement model variants, training procedures including RLVR-based approaches, and evaluation protocols using PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem

  • Track and log experiments systematically using Weights & Biases or equivalent — maintaining reproducibility standards throughout

  • Explore the intersection of LLM reasoning and crypto-native data: on-chain signals, market microstructure, multi-modal market intelligence — identifying research opportunities unique to Binance's position

  • Collaborate with applied engineering teams to understand how research findings translate into production constraints in a zero-downtime, 24/7 trading environment

• Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field strongly preferred;

  • Expected graduation in 2026, 2027, or 2028

  • Strong Python programming skills and PyTorch proficiency; C++ or Rust exposure a plus. Equally important: demonstrated comfort with vibe coding — using AI-assisted development tools fluidly as part of your research and experimentation workflow

  • Solid understanding of transformer architectures, large language model pretraining, and the evolution toward reasoning models

Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.
 
About Binance Accelerator Program
Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.
 
Who may apply
Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws

lists.content:
• Support reporting and monitoring of metrics and Key Risk Indicators (KRI) at the divisional levels
  • Continuously monitor cases and reports to identify trends, track risk anomalies, and escalate key findings to management
  • Support case analysis and risk investigations by assisting with user reports and risk signals, identifying key risk characteristics, and improving risk strategies for high-risk and organized case
  • Assist in optimizing AI tools and workflows to enhance risk operations, process automation, automated alerting, and cross-functional project tracking

• Undergraduate in a quantitative discipline, such as Mathematics/Statistics, Actuarial Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or Life Sciences
  • Basic understanding of the blockchain or cryptocurrency industry, with an interest in risk control and anti-fraud
  • Strong interest in AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), familiarity with basic prompt usage or automation tools is a plus
  • Strong logical reasoning skills, with the ability to make independent judgments based on research
  • Good cross-functional communication and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple task queues with a sense of urgency
  • Ability to learn and adapt to new software technologies
  • Knowledge or experience with SQL/Datawind is a plus

lists.content:
• Assist in planning and executing marketing campaigns targeted at retail users, including promotions, product launches, and engagement strategies.
  • Assist in preparing campaign proposals, submitting budgets for approval, and compiling post-campaign reports to analyze performance and ROI.
  • Help coordinate and host both online and offline events such as product showcases, community meetups, webinars, and promotional activations.
  • Foster and manage user communities across platforms (e.g., Telegram, Facebook, etc.), engage with members, and monitor community sentiment.
  • Constantly work on new campaigns, channels, creatives and other ideas for experimentation, optimization and acquisition growth
  • Support the recruitment, onboarding, and engagement of volunteer brand ambassadors through our Angel Program. Ensure alignment with campaign goals and track their contributions.
  • Moderate local forums, social platforms and chat groups to interact with the community and increase positive engagement.
  • Coordinating inter-department cooperation between the Angels and the Binance team (including BD, Marketing, collecting leads, market research, data requests, etc.).
  • Execute all marketing efforts with hands on approach

• Experience launching community initiatives (e.g. building an online forum, launching an ambassador program, creating an event series and writing an email newsletter.
  • Experience in managing online/offline events.
  • Experience managing social media : Instagram, Facebook, Telegram).
  • Be able to work flexible and stretched hours to interact with the crypto community as frequently as possible.
  • Excellent organizational skills, Ability to Multitask with great time management skills needed.
  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • A team player with a positive attitude and a willingness to learn.
  • Understanding of cryptocurrency related terminologies and trends and have a liking for crypto cultures.

• Create, edit, and produce short-form video content (Reels, TikToks, Shorts, etc.) that capitalizes on internet trends to drive impressions and engagement
  • Harness trending audio, formats, and memes to produce timely video content across platforms
  • Work closely cross-functionally with design, content, performance marketing, product and other teams to concept and execute video-driven social campaigns
  • Collaborate with the wider global social team and external departments (product, partnerships) to promote and build the Binance brand through video storytelling
  • Assist the team across platforms in brainstorming creative ideas, with a primary focus on video-first content for both general posts and campaigns
  • Measure, report, and analyze performance of video content and campaigns across channels, translating findings into actionable, data-driven recommendations to improve future performance

• Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.
  • Strong video creation and editing skills — able to independently produce short-form videos from concept to final cut (CapCut, Premiere, After Effects, or similar tools)
  • Possessing a keen aesthetic sense, with the ability to independently create memes, four-frame cartoons, and/or videos — video being the primary medium
  • Experience in the video, media, and/or entertainment industry working with agencies, creators, or digital media companies
  • Deep expertise in the digital media landscape and capable of identifying internet trends and/or opportunities for video content
  • Exceptional creativity in content ideation, especially in visual and video formats
  • Minimum 15 hours per week commitment

lists.content:
Responsibilities

  • Conduct cutting-edge research on modern cryptographic protocols, including post-quantum cryptography, threshold signatures, signature aggregation, and proof systems for blockchain applications.
  • Explore and benchmark NIST post-quantum signature standards and emerging constructions from recent academic literature.
  • Collaborate with senior researchers and engineers to translate research outcomes into practical applications.
  • Publish research findings and contribute to open-source cryptographic projects when appropriate.

    • Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Cryptography, or a closely related field
  • Strong theoretical or practical knowledge of cryptography, in areas such as post-quantum signatures, MPC/threshold protocols, zero-knowledge proofs, or interactive proof systems (e.g., sumcheck-based protocols)
  • Proficiency in at least one of Rust, C++, or Python
  • Ability to read and reason about security proofs from academic literature

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior research experience or publications in post-quantum cryptography, threshold signatures, or verifiable computation
  • Familiarity with blockchain architectures, smart contract platforms, or on-chain signature verification constraints
  • Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to accelerate research workflows

  • Use logs/metrics/traces to understand issues; complete a dashboard + alert + runbook for one service.

lists.content:
• Observability & Automation – Set up dashboards/alerts; script repetitive ticket steps.
  • RCA & Support Insights – Participate in RCAs; log user pain points weekly; propose product fixes.
  • Agent & Skill Prototyping – Build a lightweight agent (e.g., telegram bot) with at least one reusable skill (log fetch, health check, etc.).
  • ITSM / Tools (optional) – Optimize a small workflow in incident management tooling.

Must-have

  • CS/Data/AI or related major; Linux + scripting (Shell/Python); basic SQL.
  • Good documentation – write actionable runbooks.
  • Empathy & product thinking – improve user experience from support data.
  • Basic understanding of agents and skills.

    • Nice-to-have

  • K8s, CI/CD, Terraform.
  • MLOps project experience.
  • Built a simple LLM agent or defined skills (LangChain, function calling).
  • TSM tool experience.

• Assist in planning and executing global marketing campaigns to support various business objectives, including user acquisition, activation, trading growth, and retention. Support campaign design by defining campaign rules, task structures, reward mechanisms, user journeys, and campaign configurations to ensure successful launches.
  • Support end-to-end campaign execution, including campaign setup, UAT testing, validation of campaign pages and reward distribution, monitoring campaign performance, and promptly identifying and resolving operational issues to ensure a smooth user experience.

  • Contribute to improving operational efficiency by maintaining campaign SOPs, operational documentation, and best practices. Continuously optimize campaign workflows and operational processes.

  • Monitor and analyze campaign performance by preparing daily, weekly, and post-campaign reports. Track key metrics such as participant numbers, conversion rate, trading volume, ROI, and other growth metrics to evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify optimization opportunities.

  • Analyze user behavior and campaign performance across different regions, channels, user segments, and reward strategies. Identify user drop-off points and growth opportunities, and provide data-driven recommendations to improve future campaign performance.

Basic Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree. All majors are welcome; candidates with backgrounds in Marketing, E-commerce, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Administration, or related fields are preferred.

  • Strong interest in digital marketing, growth, campaign operations, or the Web3 industry.

  • Strong analytical thinking, communication, and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.

    • Preferred Qualifications

    • Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets for data organization, analysis, and reporting.

    • Strong data sensitivity with the ability to identify trends, uncover insights, and make data-driven recommendations.

    • Previous internship or project experience in campaign operations, marketing, internet products, or data analysis is a plus.

    • Familiarity with SQL, Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools is preferred.

    • Experience using collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Notion is a plus.

    • Basic knowledge of cryptocurrency, blockchain, or the Web3 ecosystem is preferred.

Binance Accelerator Program is a concise 3-6 months program designed to have an immersive experience in the rapidly expanding Web3 space. You will be given the opportunity to experience life at Binance and understand what goes on behind the scenes of the worlds’ leading blockchain ecosystem. You will be hired under a junior fixed term contract.

Currently a Bachelors students who can work 5 days per week for a period of 6 months.

The Central Product Team at Binance is where innovation meets user experience. We're shaping the core platforms and services that support Binance’s global ecosystem, optimizing user interactions, and enhancing operational efficiency. If you're passionate about building scalable, secure solutions that drive crypto adoption, join us and be part of a team that's redefining the digital asset experience.
